result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You had a chest infection (pneumonia) in the right lower part of your lung. You were treated in hospital from 5 October to 7 October 2026. You need to take antibiotics at home for 3 more days. You may feel tired and have a cough for some time. You need a follow-up chest X-ray.

## What you need to do
1. Take Amoxicillin 500 milligrams three times a day for 3 more days. Take your last dose on 10 October 2026.
2. Go to the Radiology Department for a chest X-ray in about 6 weeks.
3. Do not book the X-ray appointment yourself. A request has been sent. You will receive an appointment by post.

## Dates and medicines
- Admitted to hospital: 5 October 2026
- Discharged from hospital: 7 October 2026
- Amoxicillin 500 milligrams, three times a day, for 3 more days. Last dose: 10 October 2026. You already took 2 days of antibiotics in hospital. This completes your 5-day course.
- Repeat chest X-ray: in about 6 weeks from discharge

## Questions to ask your doctor
- How will I know if my chest infection is completely better?
- What should I do if I still feel very tired?
- Why do I need a follow-up chest X-ray?

## When to get urgent help
- You become more short of breath
- Your fever comes back
- You cough up blood

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
